svg.title: Application architecture
svg.desc: Local draft ownership is separate from server state; the server enforces workspace access. Arrows summarize selected dependencies and flows; this is not a complete class diagram.

svg.title: Pay Period Planner application architecture
svg.desc: A canonical local draft is distinct from the last server snapshot in Redux. HTTP requests cross a session, CSRF and workspace authorization boundary before reaching versioned relational storage.
